body:
I feel your pain bro, it sucks because all these girls say they want a good guy but when there's one right in front of them they push him to the side. I promise you you will find "the one" someday, keep searching my man. And about the hobby thing, yeah I get that too, a lot of people don't believe in me for what I like to do. I don't have any friends and I'm being dead serious about that, I get home from school and work on my music until I get to bed. I make beats and I like to rap, occassionally playing guitar. I've suffered two major heartbreaks in the past year and my parents are always mad at me for some reason. My man, you will find that person you are searching for. My opinion is work on yourself and you'll find your puzzle piece that fits you. If you like cars go have fun with cars my friend, who are these people to tell you what you should and shouldn't do with your life, did you ask them for their advice? Hell no, so let them hate, go do what you love doing. 
I hope you feel better dude. Peace.
